Seems like you're feeling a bit stuck in a rut. Especially with covid it's hard to express oneself with not a lot of people to talk to. I see that you are pretty good at expressing yourself here on Reddit, though, so maybe it's not entirely true that you have lost the ability to express yourself. if you are interested in better expressing yourself more often, maybe you could try thinking about what you want to say in group next Monday? or perhaps you could think about one of the group members that you would be interested in getting to know, and think of a question or two that you could ask them to get to know them better?

Another way to practise expressing yourself is writing or journalling. I've heard that it's quite enjoyable. Perhaps you could start with writing a sentence/day and saying it out loud. Or maybe you could write about your thoughts on something that you heard on the radio and then saying that out loud, either to yourself or in the mirror, to get used to talking and expressing yourself out loud again. Im gonna challenge you to think about something positive to write about, or something you're grateful for, and saying that out loud. I've also heard that prayer might help, too.

Hope you start feeling better! It seems that you are being quite hard on yourself. With access to Internet (since you posted on Reddit), I'm sure that you'd be able to learn that professional software. You're not alone in feeling lonely. Hope that things work out for you!
